tools.name: get_quote_status
tools.description: Check whether a previously submitted quotation enquiry is still waiting for human pricing or has been quoted.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Create a generic quotation enquiry for human pricing. This submits a real enquiry, so only call it after the user has agreed to submit their details.

tools.name: request_titanium_quote
tools.description: Submit a structured titanium material enquiry for human pricing. Only call after the customer has reviewed the interpreted requirement and explicitly agreed to submit it.
